% Pattern: number/setcounter-preamble. \setcounter{section}{-1} before
% \begin{document} makes the first section 0. Seen in the gold pilot (set X).
% want theorem-1 statement/theorem 0.1 status=none
% want lemma-1 statement/lemma 1.1 status=none
\documentclass{amsart}
\newtheorem{theorem}{Theorem}[section]
\newtheorem{lemma}[theorem]{Lemma}
\setcounter{section}{-1}
\begin{document}
\section{Introduction}
\begin{theorem} Every compact space is bounded. \end{theorem}
\section{Products}
\begin{lemma} Every finite product of compact spaces is compact. \end{lemma}
\end{document}
